name: bunbird
description: Build small web apps with an AI agent, preview them live and publish them to your Bunbird organisation, through one hosted MCP connector. You sign in when you connect.

interface.longDescription: Bunbird is an agent-first platform for small web apps made for a group of people, with sign-in, data, files, live updates and background work provided by the platform. An agent reads the author's guide, builds a draft in one of your organisations, shows a live preview, and publishes it when you say so. Access is by invitation. Apps belong to an organisation, and people outside it can be invited into an app as guests. This package connects your agent to Bunbird's hosted MCP connector, which asks you to sign in when you connect, and teaches it the flow.
defaultPrompt: Build me a small web app with Bunbird.
Show me a live preview of this app.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: build, preview and publish small web apps with Bunbird through one OAuth MCP connector.
